headline: Crypto Focuses on Binance Hack Fallout, US Jobs Report, and Midterms
summary: Cryptocurrency markets enter the week of November 2 monitoring fallout from a Binance hack alongside upcoming U.S. midterm elections and official employment data.
why: Binance is the largest global cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. U.S. macroeconomic indicators and political shifts frequently influence broader crypto liquidity and market risk appetite.
